name: Facility Utilization
query: select f.name as "Facility:Link/Sports Facility:160", count(fb.name) as "Bookings:Int:100", coalesce(sum(timestampdiff(minute, fb.start_time, fb.end_time)), 0)/60 as "Booked Hours:Float:110" from `tabSports Facility` f left join `tabFacility Booking` fb on fb.court = f.name and fb.booking_status not in ('Cancelled', 'No-show') group by f.name order by f.name
